path.description: The query's path in the library, starting with /

source.description: The NQE source; required unless delete is true

message.description: The commit title (default: Save or Remove plus the path)

create_directory.description: Create the enclosing directories that do not exist yet, in the same commit

changes.description: several queries committed in ONE commit (replaces path and source); message is the commit title

basis_commit_id.description: with changes: the library head the edits were made against; refused if the head is another commit

typecheck.description: with changes: have Forward type the changes and every query that imports them (stages drafts, restores them)

snapshot_id.description: with typecheck: also type against this snapshot's data model
